_comment: Domain randomisation for Budget-19. Ranges are the BRIDGE-style starting set from sim/README.md; they are engineering guesses until sim/sysid.py has real servo data. 'scale' = multiply nominal, 'add' = add to nominal, 'range' = absolute uniform range.

body_mass.note: printed parts vary with infill/filament; servos are +/-2 g

tau_stall.note: datasheet stall is optimistic; sysid.py reports the real number

zero_offset_rad.note: horn mounting error before software zero calibration

gravity_tilt_deg.note: IMU mounting tilt applied to the observation

push.note: random horizontal force on the torso
